Creates instructions for further processing in an already uploaded directory.
A trigger file and a metadata file will be created.
A dialog is opened first for this.

sendmail_tip:
When checked, an email is sent after
the upload to the import directory is completed.
address_tip:
Email address for the notification after a successful upload.
Usually your address or that of the person who initiated the upload.
log_tip:
When checked, a log file is generated.
A dialog is opened after the copy process is completed.
start_tip:
Starts the copy process for the selected folders
to the import directory.
